rule: Centralise all localStorage key strings in `src/constants/localStorage.ts`; do not scatter inline string literals across components.
rationale: Reviewer asked for a dedicated constants file so every localStorage key is discoverable and avoids silent key collisions across DAGs.

evidence.excerpt: make a `src/constants/localStorage.ts` file to keep track

rule: When a persisted UI state value (e.g. `dagView`) becomes invalid because a required URL context (e.g. `runId`) is absent, add a `useEffect` to coerce the stored value back to a valid default.
rationale: Without coercion, `dagView === 'gantt'` with no `runId` renders the wrong branch and the view toggle has no matching option.

rule: Extract shared visual constants (gradient strings, pixel offsets, colours) that are used across two or more components into the nearest `constants.ts` file for the feature folder.
rationale: Reviewer required `NOTE_GRADIENT` to be factored into `Grid/constants.ts` using a pixel-based split instead of duplicating the string inline.

evidence.excerpt: Factorize this with the TI one. Put it in `Grid/constants.ts`

rule: Use `total_entries` from the API response for displaying counts when a hard `limit` is applied; never use `array.length` as the displayed count.
rationale: When total entries exceed the page limit, using `.length` silently undercounts; `total_entries` is the authoritative count.

evidence.excerpt: hard-limits query to 20 but uses `missedDeadlines.length` — will undercount

rule: When a component queries with a hard `limit`, check `data.total_entries > limit` and show a '+ N more' affordance (e.g. a modal) rather than silently truncating results.
rationale: Reviewer stated 'People's Airflow use cases can get crazy'; always surface overflow to the user instead of silently hiding results.

evidence.excerpt: if deadlineData.totalEntries > 10, add '+ X more' button

rule: Filter-reset logic must not delete the ordering/sort search param; only clear actual filter params.
rationale: Bulk `searchParams.delete` calls that include ordering params remove the sort preference the user did not ask to reset.

evidence.excerpt: This will remove 'ordering' too — not what we want

rule: Do not use `Boolean(value)` to test whether a filter is active; check `value !== undefined && value !== null` so that valid falsy values (e.g. `map_index = 0`) are correctly counted as active filters.
rationale: Reviewer noted that `Boolean(0)` returns `false`, making `map_index = 0` appear unfiltered — a known bug class in the Airflow UI filter-count helpers.

evidence.excerpt: `Boolean(0)` returns 'false', no filter applied but there is a filter

rule: Filter inputs that are redundant in a context-specific view (e.g. DAG ID filter when `dagId` is already in the URL path) must be hidden via conditional rendering.
rationale: Reviewer required conditional rendering to suppress the DAG ID filter when the component is embedded inside a DAG-scoped view.

evidence.excerpt: if `dagId` from the path is defined, hide via conditional rendering

rule: Feature sub-components must be grouped in a named folder (e.g. `TaskFilters/`) with a single barrel export; only the folder's root component is imported from outside.
rationale: Reviewer required a `TaskFilters` folder mirroring the `DagsList` pattern so the external interface is a single named export.

evidence.excerpt: move everything related to filters inside a `TaskFilters` folder

rule: Reset the pagination OFFSET search param whenever a filter mode (e.g. tag match mode) changes to avoid landing on an empty page.
rationale: Changing tag match mode from 'any' to 'all' can reduce result count below the current offset, leaving the user on a blank page.

evidence.excerpt: reset OFFSET when changing the match mode — could leave blank page

rule: Check API error HTTP status using `(error as ExpandedApiError).status` or optional-chaining `error?.status`; do not use `instanceof ApiError`.
rationale: Reviewer required consistent status-check style across the UI codebase; `instanceof` is not used elsewhere for API errors.

evidence.excerpt: don't check `instanceof ApiError` to keep things consistent

rule: Normalize field values (e.g. `"" → undefined/null`) before comparing against the initial value to build `updateMask`; do not push a field into `updateMask` based on an un-normalized comparison.
rationale: Comparing un-normalized form value against initial value causes spurious `updateMask` entries when the effective value is unchanged (e.g. initial `undefined` vs form `""`).

evidence.excerpt: Normalize first, then decide whether to push into `updateMask`

rule: When the UI must clear an existing server-side field, send `null` (not `undefined`) in the request body so the field is included in `model_fields_set` on the backend.
rationale: Empty-string→`undefined` omits the field from JSON; the backend only applies fields in `model_fields_set`, so the existing value is never cleared.

evidence.excerpt: makes it impossible to clear an existing team assignment from the UI

rule: Use the OpenAPI-generated react-query hooks for all API calls; do not make raw `fetch` calls with manually encoded query strings.
rationale: Reviewer stated manual fetch + query-string encoding is inconsistent with the rest of the codebase which uses generated hooks throughout.

evidence.excerpt: Manual encoding of parameters and fetch is inconsistent with rest of codebase

rule: Do not prop-drill URL search-param values (e.g. `tryNumber`) through multiple component levels; read them directly from `useSearchParams` in the consuming component.
rationale: Reviewer required reading `tryNumber` from `useSearchParams` inside `ExtraLinks` instead of threading it down from a parent.

evidence.excerpt: don't drill tryNumber prop — use `useSearchParams` and undefined if absent

rule: Use Chakra semantic color tokens in `.tsx` component files; do not reference hardcoded Tailwind/color-scale strings outside a designated theme/utils file.
rationale: Reviewer questioned static component listings of hardcoded colours; semantic tokens should be used everywhere so the analysis file is unnecessary.

evidence.excerpt: check for semantic colors in every .tsx file
